raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "cantilever_basic design domain",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 requires Lx and Ly, but neither Table 3 nor a row-specific prompt supplies them. Element counts do not establish physical aspect ratio.",
      "readings": [
        "Rectangle with Lx=2, Ly=1.",
        "Rectangle with Lx=3, Ly=1.",
        "Rectangle with Lx=60, Ly=30."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "cantilever_basic element counts",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Table 3 gives no mesh. Its compliance matches cantilever_60x30 in Table 5, and Algorithm 2 defaults to 60x30, but the text never explicitly maps the two identifiers. Sec. 4.1 also lists a 120x40 standard cantilever.",
      "readings": [
        "60x30 elements, using the default and matching Table 5 entry.",
        "120x40 elements, treating cantilever_basic as the other standard resolution."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "2-D finite elements",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 specifies assembly and a sparse direct solve, but not element interpolation, quadrature, or stabilization.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2x2 Gauss integration.",
        "Four-node quadrilaterals with reduced integration and hourglass stabilization.",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3x3 Gauss integration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "load at the free end",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 supplies only 'tip load'. The mid-right examples in Secs. 1.3 and 4.1 describe a cantilever with a hole and are not identified as cantilever_basic.",
      "readings": [
        "Right-edge midpoint: x=Lx, y=Ly/2.",
        "Lower-right corner: x=Lx, y=0.",
        "Upper-right corner: x=Lx, y=Ly."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "free-end load application",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The actual load specification is absent. 'Tip load' does not establish whether the resultant acts at one node or is spread over the end boundary; Secs. 3.1–3.2 support both point and distributed loads.",
      "readings": [
        "Concentrated force at one nearest node.",
        "Same resultant distributed over three adjacent end nodes with weights 1/4, 1/2, 1/4.",
        "Uniform traction over the entire right edge, assembled using Eq. 3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "free-end force vector",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Table 3 nor the generic cantilever rule states the direction for this row. The downward-load examples are not explicitly this case.",
      "readings": [
        "Transverse downward force: direction (0,-1).",
        "Axial outward force: direction (1,0).",
        "Oblique force: direction (1,-1)/sqrt(2)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "total applied force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No force magnitude or units are published for cantilever_basic. The Fy=-1 illustration in Sec. 4.1 accompanies the hole example.",
      "readings": [
        "Total resultant magnitude 1 in consistent force units.",
        "Total resultant magnitude 10 in the same units.",
        "Total resultant magnitude 100 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "cantilever_basic target volume fraction",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 gives a default of 0.5, but Table 3 does not publish the row's prompt or target. Sec. 4.1 lists other fractions without a row-specific assignment.",
      "readings": [
        "Vf=0.5, applying the configurator default.",
        "Vf=0.4, supplied as a prompt override.",
        "Vf=0.6, supplied as a prompt override."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "cantilever_basic passive-element mask",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The row's passive-region set is not printed. Naming separate hole and insert benchmarks does not specify whether the basic case includes solid attachment pads.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive regions; every element is designable.",
        "One element column next to the fixed edge is passive solid.",
        "A passive-solid pad of elements adjacent to the loaded node."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "2-D constitutive model",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 does not provide the base elasticity matrix, material symmetry, or plane assumption.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic plane stress.",
        "Isotropic plane strain.",
        "Orthotropic plane stress with the stiff material axis parallel to x."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson ratio under an isotropic interpretation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson ratio is stated anywhere for this example.",
      "readings": [
        "nu=0.2.",
        "nu=0.3.",
        "nu=0.45."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "solid-material Young modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No solid modulus or stiffness normalization is stated. These alternatives hold all dimensionless elastic constants and stiffness-floor ratios fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalized E0=1.",
        "E0=70 GPa in consistent physical units.",
        "E0=210 GPa in consistent physical units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 2-D model has no stated thickness or explicit unit-thickness convention. These readings hold the applied resultant forces fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness t=1 in the chosen length unit.",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.1 in the same unit."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "SIMP stiffness interpolation and residual stiffness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 names SIMP without its stiffness formula or modulus floor. The stated density floor rho_min=0.001 does not determine an independent minimum modulus.",
      "readings": [
        "E(rho)=E0*rho^p with no additional modulus floor.",
        "E(rho)=Emin+(E0-Emin)*rho^p with Emin/E0=1e-9.",
        "Same interpolation with Emin/E0=1e-6."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "controller used for the configuration-accuracy comparison",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 4.4 and Table 3 specify the LLM controller, whereas the associated Figure 5 caption specifies the schedule controller.",
      "readings": [
        "Use the LLM controller, following Table 3 and Sec. 4.4.",
        "Use the deterministic schedule controller, following Figure 5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "main-phase initial continuation parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 describes an initialization method returning p, beta, r_min and delta, but does not publish its values for this run. The numerical tail settings do not determine these starting values.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize (p,beta,r_min,delta)=(1,1,1.5,0.20).",
        "Initialize (p,beta,r_min,delta)=(3,1,2.0,0.10)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "main-phase continuation and restart history",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.3 and 4.2 provide neither the realized LLM parameter/action trace nor a numerical four-phase schedule. Initialization and the common tail alone cannot reproduce the exploration.",
      "readings": [
        "Raise p before beta, retain the initial filter radius until the tail, and perform no main-phase restart.",
        "Raise p and beta together, tighten the filter during exploration, and restart from the best valid snapshot after a compliance spike."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "LLM controller observation interval",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.2 says the controller observes every k iterations but never assigns k.",
      "readings": [
        "k=1.",
        "k=5.",
        "k=10."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density-filter weights",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 5 specifies normalized weights within r_min but does not define their dependence on distance.",
      "readings": [
        "Linear cone weights: max(0,r_min-distance).",
        "Uniform weights for all centroids within r_min.",
        "Gaussian weights with standard deviation r_min/2, truncated at r_min."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter-radius units and distance metric",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The tail radius is explicitly 1.20, but Secs. 3.3 and 4.2 do not say whether distances use element indices or physical coordinates.",
      "readings": [
        "Radius 1.20 in Euclidean element-index coordinates.",
        "Radius 1.20 in the physical coordinate units of Lx and Ly.",
        "Physical radius equal to 1.20 times the horizontal element width."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Heaviside projection",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 5 names H_beta without its formula or threshold. Specifying beta, including the tail value, does not determine the projection.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalized tanh projection with fixed threshold eta=0.5.",
        "Normalized tanh projection with fixed threshold eta=0.3.",
        "Normalized tanh projection with eta adjusted each iteration to preserve filtered volume."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial main-phase density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 6 specifies uniform initialization only for a tail without a valid snapshot. The initial density field for the ordinary main solve is not stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform raw density rho=Vf.",
        "Uniform raw density rho=1.",
        "Seed-42 random perturbations within Vf±0.01, recentered to mean Vf."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "OC density-update formula",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.2–3.3 name OC and its move limit but do not give the multiplicative update or damping exponent.",
      "readings": [
        "Multiplicative OC with exponent 1/2, clipped by move and density bounds.",
        "Multiplicative OC with exponent 1/3, clipped by the same bounds."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "OC multiplier-bisection controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The OC bisection is mentioned in Sec. 3.2, but its bracket, stopping tolerance and iteration cap are absent.",
      "readings": [
        "Bracket [0,1e9], relative interval tolerance 1e-3, maximum 100 steps.",
        "Adaptively expanded bracket, relative interval tolerance 1e-6, maximum 200 steps."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "300-iteration budget accounting",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Table 3 says 300 iterations and Sec. 4.2 specifies a 40-iteration tail. Sec. 5.2 calls 300 iterations exploration, but Table 3 does not explicitly state whether its budget follows that accounting.",
      "readings": [
        "300 main iterations followed by 40 tail iterations: 340 total.",
        "260 main iterations followed by 40 tail iterations: 300 total."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "solver early-exit policy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.3 mentions early exit, compliance stability and functional convergence as evaluator evidence, but gives no operational solver stopping rule or stability-window length.",
      "readings": [
        "Run the full main budget and full 40-iteration tail.",
        "End the main phase when maximum raw-density change is below 0.001, then run the tail.",
        "End the main phase when relative compliance range is below 0.005 over 10 iterations, then run the tail."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
